text:
Alex: dropped a quick mock and some notes — thinking about making the timepicker sticky when you scroll the latency dashboard. helps keep range context while you inspect p95/heatmap, but not sure how it should behave with the sampling chip + scrubber. figma -> https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/sticky-timepicker Priya: I like the idea. couple concerns: on smaller breakpoints the sticky header will reduce vertical space and the sampling chip currently sits near the top-right. could end up occluding the scrubber or the heatmap legend. also keyboard focus — will sticking reorder focus? Jon: agree with Priya. also: when the timepicker is sticky the p95 tooltip that floats near the top gets pushed down. we need rules for tooltip stacking/context. maybe move p95 tooltip above the sticky bar when present, or pin it to series point with connector. Marta: accessibility nit: the sampling chip ("Sampling: 1/100") should announce changes via aria-live so screen reader users know sample rate changed after toggles or when sampling auto-adjusts. also ensure the sticky region has proper skip links ("Skip to heatmap"). DesignBot: contrast check: sampling chip bg #1E90FF at 14px fails AA on dark text. recommend #0B63D6 or use white text with semi-opaque dark bg. Alex: good notes. here's a tiny aria example I prototyped for the chip — keeps it simple so live updates are picked up: ```
Sampling: 1/100
``` Priya: that aria-live looks fine. for keyboard: when timepicker becomes sticky, I'd keep the tab order identical (no shortcuts created). maybe add `aria-hidden` to non-interactive duplicates if we need a visual clone. Jon: on the tooltip/positioning side, I sketched logic: if stickyBar.visible && tooltip.y < stickyBar.bottom + 8px then move tooltip above stickyBar and draw connector. fallback: Nudge chart up 48px on sticky to avoid overlap (configurable). Marta: +1 for aria-hidden duplicate approach. also add a visible focus outline when the sticky header is active — users should be able to tell keyboard focus moved into the sticky area. Alex: action items: I will update figma with two variants (sticky preserves chart vs sticky nudges chart) and try the color suggestion from DesignBot. I'll also add the aria-live wrapper. @Priya can you run keyboard flows on the nudged variant? @Jon can you prototype tooltip reposition in the playground? @Marta can you run a quick screen reader pass? Priya: yes, I can test today — will post short notes in this thread. Jon: I'll mock the tooltip behavior in the playground by EOD. Marta: I'll do a quick JAWS/VoiceOver pass tomorrow morning and report back. DesignBot: reminder: updated contrast rule applied. no further issues flagged once chip color is #0B63D6 with white text. Alex: thanks everyone. keeping this thread as the single source for the iteration. I'll open a tiny PR for the chip color + aria patch after I update figma. Priya: :thumbsup: Jon: :rocket: Marta: thanks!
